base: v11 = v10 + 0.217*(stack-5 - v10), fold-side, exp-039 v10.load() and exp-036 bases.load()
rotation: score fold f, fit on the OTHER two fold months. Only 2025-01, 2025-07 and 2025-12 carry an out-of-fold v11 residual, so 'the 2025 months other than the scored fold' is those two.
amplitude: one weight per airport, fitted on the fitting months only, clipped to [0, 1]. An airport with fewer than MIN_AIRPORT_ROWS fitting rows gets weight 0 and is left at v11.
cross_fit: day blocks inside the fitting months: 5 contiguous blocks per month, a row's prediction always comes from a model that did not see its block

arms.a_linear: p11 + w_airport * (obs_taxi - offset_airport - p11) on matched rows
arms.b_lgb: p11 + s_airport * lgb(feature block -> r11) on matched rows
arms.c_lgb_shipped: arm b with the 76 non-vocabulary numeric columns of the shipped feature block beside the observation

gate: all-row paired gain over v11 with every fold interval clear of zero
noac: d = 0 on every noac row, by construction and checked
